title.title: A good title
points: Sum up your problem in one sentence: the tech, what you're trying to do, what's blocking you.
"Flutter: offline sync creates duplicates" beats "Help pls!".
A precise title attracts the right people, and helps whoever searches for the same thing after you.

tags.title: Choosing tags
points: Up to 5 tags: the technology (React, Spring Boot…) and the topic (Performance, Career…).
Your question lands in the feed of the devs who follow these tags.
Prefer a tag that already exists: it is suggested as you type.

points: What you want to achieve, and what happens instead.

Your versions and environment: phone, browser, system.
